content: The execution was successful (reward 1.0). The strategy of unzipping the HWPX (ZIP-based) file, iterating through all XML files, and performing paragraph-level text merging was effective. Crucially, the removal of `<hp:lineSegArray>` elements in modified paragraphs prevented rendering artifacts (layout cache issues) common in HWPX manipulation. The implementation used `lxml` to handle namespaces dynamically and ensured all placeholders were replaced by consolidating text into the first `<hp:t>` element of each paragraph. This approach robustly handles placeholders that might have been split across multiple text runs during document editing.
